newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Used cars (in UAE) find way to Afghanistan.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan in talks with Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam.
- UAE protests to Iran (over incursion by vessel).
- UAE leaders send condolences to King Fahd of Saudi Arabia.
- UAE's offset scheme terms not to be eased.
- Chrysler plans training centre in Dubai.
- Sheikh Zaid gets letter from Syrian President Hafez al-Assad.
- Gulf Arab mediation committee meets in Jeddah to pursue efforts to mend fences between Qatar and Bahrain.
